preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= N <= 10**5 for N, K in zip(Ns, Ks))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of the array N and the parameter K satisfy 1 <= K <= N <= 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**6 for A in As for i in range(len(A)))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A is between 1 and 10^6.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == 'YES' if all(A[i] == A[N-i-1] for i in range(N//2)) else 'NO' for i, (N, A) in enumerate(zip(Ns, As)))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is 'YES' if the array can be made palindromic, otherwise 'NO'.
